character: Detective O'Riley and Wolf Heimlich after Carter's murder
voice: O'Riley remains patronizing and territorial while Heimlich remains militant and severe; both use readable speech rather than national caricature.

entries.text: Don't trouble your little head about it, lass.
This is an official murder investigation, Miss Bow. Do not interfere.
Dr. Carter died because someone stuck a gift-shop dagger in his chest. What more do you need to know?
Someone who didn't like him. There's my professional opinion.
If you think you can do better--
Excellent. Now the amateurs are involved.
Stay out of my way, lass, and don't destroy the evidence.
You cannot play the game without studying the Egyptian gods. I've half a mind to arrest you for wasting my time.
The detective may arrest you. I will conduct the interrogation.
